name: Kanidm
description: Kanidm is a modern, simple and secure identity management platform written in Rust. It provides OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP, RADIUS and Unix (PAM/nsswitch) authentication, WebAuthn/passkey support and a self-service web portal for managing people, groups and service accounts.

notes.text: Kanidm needs a domain name, not a bare IP. Open https://kanidm.<IP>.nip.io:8443 and accept the self-signed certificate.
To use your own domain, or if your DNS blocks nip.io, set domain and origin in /etc/kanidm/server.toml before creating accounts. Changing them later needs a domain rename.
Create the admin passwords inside the container with kanidmd recover-account idm_admin (signs in to the web portal) and kanidmd recover-account admin.
